text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
King-chaaan! Hooray! Hooray! You can do 
it~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was training with King Halo today, but 
for some reason Haru Urara was cheering 
for her the entire time.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange after all, isn't it? It's 
been like this all morning—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... King-chan... Good luck getting 
changed... *yawn*...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm already changed, but... More 
importantly, you need to hurry up and get 
changed yourself, Urara-san!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, take off that tracksuit...! 
You're going to be late again.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, King-chan... Good luck... 
getting to school~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You need to push harder than me, 
Urara-san! We're really going to be late!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Keep up the hard work studying during your 
break too~! Fight! Fight!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Urara-san!? Why did you come all 
the way to our classroom...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, no, more importantly! Urara-san, 
didn't you say you had a test today too, 
right!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah!? That's right!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Jeez... I'll just give you the main 
points, so sit down next to me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Or something along those lines.
choice_data_list:
...Maybe you did something that made 
people want to cheer for you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Nothing comes to mind, but... there 
might be some circumstances behind it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Urara-san, do you have a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! King-chan! What's wrong? Are you 
taking a rest??

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll cheer you on so you can 
get plenty of good rest!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Stop, stop! Why have you been cheering for 
me this whole time?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: This is a little thank-you for King-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Guess what? The teacher praised me the 
other day, saying 'You're being late less 
often' and 'Your test scores have gone up 
a bit'!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So, I started wondering why that was...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's because King-chan is always 
cheering me on, saying "Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I realized that it was all thanks to 
King-chan!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Urara-san...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it is, then— No, pull 
yourself together!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, that's true. I gotta be able to 
cheer in a "first-class" way!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not! What I wanted to say was, 
like...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Your spirit is first-class! This King 
acknowledges that!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wait, so King-chan was happy with it? 
Yaaaay~~!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Your spirit is, at least! That's why I'm 
telling you that your actions need to 
become first-class as well!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see! Okay, got it! Urara's gonna do her 
best for King-chan's sake too!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"You always... really know how to strike a 
chord with such straightforward words..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? King-chan, are you okay?? Your eyes 
are all teary! Does something hurt!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "This is... um, you know! So, errr......."
choice_data_list: It's pretty dusty today, isn't it~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right! My nose just tickled 
because of the dust!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she sniffled while speaking, her 
expression seemed wonderfully happy.
